title: ViTacPhys: Physical Property-Aware Grasping from Human Visual-Tactile Demonstrations
summary: Recent vision-based action models have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex manipulation, but they rarely leverage explicit object physical properties to adapt their policies. We introduce ViTacPhys, a visual-tactile framework and data acquisition system that estimates object mass and friction-coefficient classes, together with continuous stiffness, from human manipulation demonstrations. Trained on data from 60 rigid and deformable objects, ViTacPhys combines temporal visual-tactile modeling, cross-attention multimodal fusion, and a semantic prior derived from a vision-language model. On seen objects, it achieves 97.2% mass classification accuracy, 98.8% friction-coefficient classification accuracy, and a stiffness mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 5.51%. On held-out objects from known categories, it achieves 87.5% mass accuracy, 97.5% friction-coefficient accuracy, and a stiffness MAPE of 9.08%. We transfer ViTacPhys from the human domain to the robot domain using limited robot teleoperation data, robot-style video augmentation, and human demonstrations with matched actions, and deploy it as an online module for adaptive grasping. The resulting physical-property-conditioned policy achieves total grasping success rates of 95.0% on in-distribution objects and 83.4% on out-of-distribution objects. For out-of-distribution objects successfully grasped by both methods, its force profiles are more consistent with human teleoperation than those produced by ACT. These results demonstrate the feasibility of explicitly estimating and conditioning on object physical properties for real-world adaptive grasping.
tldr: ViTacPhys estimates object mass, friction coefficient, and stiffness from human visual-tactile demonstrations, and transfers these physical priors to a robot policy for adaptive grasping, achieving high success rates on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution objects.
tldr_zh: ViTacPhys通过人类视觉-触觉演示估计物体的质量、摩擦系数和刚度，并将这些物理先验转移到机器人策略中实现自适应抓取，在分布内和分布外物体上均取得了高成功率。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
基于视觉的动作模型近年来在复杂操作任务中展现出强大能力，但鲜有方法显式利用物体物理属性来调整策略。我们提出ViTacPhys——一种视觉-触觉框架与数据采集系统，能够通过人类操作演示估计物体质量、摩擦系数类别以及连续刚度值。该系统在60个刚性及可变形物体的数据上训练，融合了时序视觉-触觉建模、交叉注意力多模态融合以及源自视觉语言模型的语义先验。在已知物体上，ViTacPhys实现97.2%的质量分类准确率、98.8%的摩擦系数分类准确率，刚度平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为5.51%；在已知类别但未训练的物体上，质量准确率为87.5%，摩擦系数准确率为97.5%，刚度MAPE为9.08%。通过有限机器人遥操作数据、机器人风格视频增强及匹配动作的人类演示，我们将ViTacPhys从人类域迁移至机器人域，并部署为自适应抓取的在线模块。基于该物理属性条件化策略，系统在分布内物体上的总抓取成功率达95.0%，在分布外物体上达83.4%。对于两种方法均成功抓取的分布外物体，其力曲线比ACT生成的力曲线更接近人类遥操作特征。这些结果证明了在真实世界自适应抓取中显式估计并条件化物体物理属性的可行性。

title: VT-MUSE: Multimodal Unified Sequential Visuotactile Representation Learning for Manipulation
summary: We propose VT-MUSE, a Multimodal Unified SEquential representation learning framework for visuotactilemanipulation. Existing approaches often encode visual and tactile observations independently before fusion, limiting their ability to capture fine-grained cross-modal dependencies. Moreover, most methods focus on observations at the current time step and overlook the temporal evolution of contact. VT-MUSE addresses both limitations through a two-stage representation learning framework. In Stage I, modality specific encoders are jointly adapted via cross-modal temporal alignment and masked-view consistency. In Stage II, a conditional variational latent model processes masked visual sequences together with full tactile histories. Auxiliary decoders reconstruct the masked recent visual observations and predict tactile depth changes, encouraging the latent representation to retain both global visual context and local contact dynamics. The learned representation is subsequently integrated into a lightweight Transformer policy through gated cross-attention. On the simulation benchmark, VT-MUSE outperforms the strongest baseline evaluated on all tasks by 11 percentage points and also achieves substantial improvements in real-world experiments.
tldr: VT-MUSE proposes a two-stage visuotactile representation learning framework that aligns visual and tactile modalities temporally and fuses them via a conditional variational latent model, achieving strong manipulation performance in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: VT-MUSE提出了一个两阶段的视觉触觉表征学习框架，通过时间对齐和条件变分潜变量模型融合多模态信息，在仿真和真实操作任务上取得了显著提升。
summary_zh: 我们提出VT-MUSE，一种面向视觉-触觉操作的多模态统一序列表示学习框架。现有方法通常在融合前独立编码视觉和触觉观测，限制了其捕获细粒度跨模态依赖的能力。此外，多数方法仅关注当前时间步的观测，忽略了接触的时间演化过程。VT-MUSE通过两阶段表示学习框架同时解决了上述局限：第一阶段，通过跨模态时间对齐和掩膜视图一致性来联合调整模态特定编码器；第二阶段，条件变分潜变量模型处理掩膜视觉序列与完整触觉历史序列。辅助解码器重构被掩膜的近期视觉观测并预测触觉深度变化，促使潜在表示同时保留全局视觉上下文与局部接触动态。最终通过门控交叉注意力将学习到的表示集成至轻量级Transformer策略中。在仿真基准测试中，VT-MUSE在所有任务上较最强基线提升11个百分点，并在真实世界实验中取得了显著改进。

title: Just Noticeable Difference Modeling for Token Compression in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Token compression has become a key technique for reducing the inference cost of large foundation models, with approaches such as token pruning and KV-cache reuse widely adopted in vision-language models and recently explored for embodied agents. In embodied agents, tokens not only support perception and semantic understanding but also directly affect latency-sensitive closed-loop robot action prediction. Existing schemes typically guide compression using redundancy or importance cues, such as visual similarity, attention scores, and saliency. However, these cues only indirectly measure the key factor for safe compression: how much a token can change before causing an unacceptable deviation in downstream actions. This receiver-dependent tolerance is closely related to the principle of just noticeable difference (JND). Classical JND characterizes signal tolerance in the human visual system, while machine-oriented JND extends this concept to downstream machine responses. Building on this progression, we introduce Action-JND, which extends JND modeling to embodied perception by defining noticeability through the language-conditioned action response of a vision-language-action (VLA) policy in closed-loop control. A token change is considered admissible only when the induced action deviation remains within a tolerated margin. To realize this concept, we develop a lightweight token-wise JND estimator in deep visual-feature space to predict the maximum tolerable perturbation while preserving policy responses. The resulting action-tolerance score serves as a plug-and-play criterion for VLA compression paradigms, including stale-KV reuse and token pruning, prioritizing action-tolerant tokens for compression. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark with OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT demonstrate that Action-JND consistently improves compression reliability, especially under aggressive compression ratios.
tldr: This paper introduces Action-JND, a just noticeable difference model for token compression in VLA models that measures token tolerance based on downstream action deviations, improving compression reliability in closed-loop control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Action-JND，一种用于视觉-语言-动作模型中令牌压缩的恰可察觉差模型，通过下游动作偏差衡量令牌容忍度，提升闭环控制中压缩的可靠性。
summary_zh: 摘要：Token压缩已成为降低大型基础模型推理成本的关键技术，其中token剪枝和KV缓存复用等方法在视觉语言模型中广泛采用，并近期被探索用于具身智能体。在具身智能体中，token不仅支持感知和语义理解，还会直接影响延迟敏感的闭环机器人动作预测。现有方案通常利用冗余性或重要性线索（如视觉相似性、注意力分数和显著性）来指导压缩。然而，这些线索仅间接衡量安全压缩的关键因素：即一个token在导致下游动作产生不可接受偏差之前，能够被改变的程度。这种依赖于接收方的容忍度与"恰可察觉差异"（JND）原理密切相关。经典JND刻画了人类视觉系统中的信号容忍度，而面向机器的JND则将这一概念扩展至下游机器响应。在此基础上，我们提出了Action-JND，通过定义语言条件化动作响应在闭环控制中因视觉-语言-动作策略而产生的可察觉性，将JND建模扩展至具身感知。仅当引起的动作偏差保持在容忍范围内时，token的改变才被认为是可接受的。为实现这一概念，我们在深层视觉特征空间中开发了一种轻量级的逐token JND估计器，用于预测在保持策略响应的前提下最大可容忍的扰动。由此产生的动作容忍度分数可作为即插即用的标准，应用于VLA压缩范式（包括陈旧KV复用和token剪枝），优先对动作容忍度高的token进行压缩。在LIBERO基准测试上使用OpenVLA和OpenVLA-OFT的实验表明，Action-JND能持续提升压缩可靠性，尤其在激进压缩比率下效果显著。

title: Beyond Imitation: Self-Improving Robot Policies via Off-Policy Q-Planning
summary: Behaviour Cloning (BC) has driven remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet it is fundamentally limited by its inability to self-improve: a policy that fails cannot learn from that failure without additional human demonstrations. Reinforcement Learning fine-tuning offers a path to self-improvement but has proven difficult to scale to the multi-billion-parameter models underpinning modern robot policies. We propose Q-Planning, which equips a large visuomotor BC policy with a small off-policy Q-function. Because a Q-function estimates value rather than imitates actions, it can be trained on the same successful demonstrations as the BC policy and later absorb both successful and failed deployment rollouts, an asymmetry BC does not have. We exploit this asymmetry to enable value-guided action selection at inference (a single-step Q-weighted average over BC draws) and online self-improvement that fine-tunes only the Q-function, leaving the BC weights untouched. On LIBERO and bimanual RoboTwin, ten iterations of self-improvement lift every benchmark score we tested (LIBERO-10 93% to 99%, RoboTwin 83.8% to 91.4%) and shorten successful episodes on the near-ceiling suites (LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal). On two contact-rich bimanual real-robot tasks, the same loop (BC frozen, no human intervention) improves purely from its own deployment rollouts: stack-cups 40% to 90% and insert-wallet 25% to 80% in five iterations, whereas SFT on successful rollouts alone stalls at 55% and 30%. Under an identical online budget Q-Planning is the only method, among Best-of-N, filtered SFT, IBRL, DSRL, and DAWR, that improves stably from failures without training an auxiliary actor.
tldr: Q-Planning enables self-improvement in frozen large BC policies by training a small off-policy Q-function on both successes and failures, using Q-weighted action selection and online Q-only fine-tuning to boost performance across simulation and real-robot tasks without human intervention.
tldr_zh: Q-Planning 通过训练一个小型离策略 Q 函数同时吸收成功和失败数据，在冻结的大型 BC 策略上实现自我改进，使用 Q 加权动作选择和仅 Q 函数在线微调，在模拟和真实机器人任务中提升性能，无需人工干预。
summary_zh: 行为克隆（BC）在机器人操作领域取得了显著进展，但其根本局限在于缺乏自我改进能力：一个失败的策略无法从失败中学习，除非获得新的人类示范。强化学习微调虽为自我改进提供了路径，但难以扩展到支撑现代机器人策略的数十亿参数模型。我们提出Q-Planning，该方法为大规模视觉运动BC策略配备一个小型离策略Q函数。由于Q函数估计的是价值而非模仿动作，它既能在与BC策略相同的成功示范数据上训练，又能吸收部署过程中成功与失败的轨迹——这种非对称性是BC所不具备的。我们利用这一非对称性，在推理阶段实现价值引导的动作选择（基于BC采样结果的单步Q值加权平均），并在在线自我改进中仅微调Q函数，保持BC权重不变。在LIBERO和双臂RoboTwin数据集上，经过十轮自我改进，所有测试基准分数均获提升（LIBERO-10从93%升至99%，RoboTwin从83.8%升至91.4%），接近天花板的任务套件（LIBERO-Object、LIBERO-Goal）的成功回合时间也得以缩短。在两项接触密集的双臂真实机器人任务中，相同循环（BC冻结、无人工干预）仅凭自身部署轨迹即实现改进：叠杯任务五轮迭代从40%提升至90%，插卡任务从25%提升至80%，而仅依赖成功轨迹的SFT方法则停滞在55%和30%。在相同在线预算下，Q-Planning是Best-of-N、过滤SFT、IBRL、DSRL和DAWR中唯一无需训练辅助Actor即可从失败中稳定改进的方法。

title: Roadside-Cooperative Autonomous Driving: From Data Platform to Vision-Language End-to-End Reasoning
summary: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) cooperation enables beyond-line-of-sight perception, mitigating occlusions in single-vehicle sensing. However, existing V2X benchmarks provide limited support for closed-loop evaluation and language-grounded supervision, hindering the development of vision-language models (VLMs) for end-to-end cooperative driving. To address these limitations, we introduce V2XBench, a simulation platform featuring synchronized ego--roadside sensing and closed-loop evaluation, together with Chat-V2XBench, a progressively structured VQA dataset for cooperative reasoning. Building upon this benchmark infrastructure, we propose AURORA, an end-to-end cooperative driving framework. Equipped with a dual-view perception architecture, AURORA mitigates spatial and semantic discrepancies across ego and roadside viewpoints through a query-level Cross-View Query Alignment and Fusion (CQAF) module. Leveraging the resulting unified tokens, a LoRA-adapted VLM bridges semantic reasoning and generative trajectory planning. Extensive closed-loop evaluations on V2XBench demonstrate that AURORA achieves state-of-the-art performance in heavily occluded scenarios, with a Route Completion rate of 98.21% and a Driving Score of 76.02, while requiring low roadside communication bandwidth. Ultimately, this work pioneers an extensible V2X--VLM paradigm, paving the way for next-generation cooperative autonomous driving.
tldr: This paper introduces V2XBench, a V2X simulation platform with closed-loop evaluation, and proposes AURORA, an end-to-end cooperative driving framework that uses a dual-view perception architecture and a LoRA-adapted VLM for vision-language reasoning and trajectory planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了V2XBench，一个支持闭环评估的V2X仿真平台，并提出了AURORA，一个端到端协同驾驶框架，利用双视角感知架构和LoRA适配的VLM进行视觉-语言推理与轨迹规划。
summary_zh: 车辆与万物互联（V2X）协作实现了超视距感知，有效缓解了单车感知中的遮挡问题。然而，现有V2X基准数据集对闭环评估和语言引导监督的支持有限，制约了面向端到端协同驾驶的视觉语言模型（VLM）发展。为解决上述局限，我们提出V2XBench——一种具备自车-路侧同步感知与闭环评估功能的仿真平台，以及Chat-V2XBench——一个用于协同推理的渐进式结构化视觉问答数据集。基于该基准基础设施，我们进一步提出端到端协同驾驶框架AURORA。通过双视角感知架构，AURORA借助查询级跨视角查询对齐与融合模块（CQAF），有效缓解了自车与路侧视角间的空间与语义差异。利用由此产生的统一表征向量，经LoRA适配的VLM实现了语义推理与生成式轨迹规划的无缝衔接。在V2XBench上的大量闭环评估表明，AURORA在严重遮挡场景下达到了业界领先性能：路线完成率达98.21%，驾驶评分为76.02，同时仅需较低的路侧通信带宽。最终，本工作开创了可扩展的V2X-VLM范式，为下一代协同式自动驾驶铺平了道路。

title: Fast Coordinated Bimanual Motion Planning With Hard Constraints
summary: Bimanual manipulation enables complex tasks but introduces added complexity from the high number of degrees of freedom involved. When handling rigid objects, the relative transformation between the two end effectors must remain fixed throughout the motion, manifesting as a nonlinear equality constraint that confines the feasible configuration space to a measure-zero manifold and challenges conventional motion planners. We propose a fast bimanual motion planning pipeline that enforces this hard transformation constraint continuously along the entire path, using a leader-follower parameterization: the leader's configuration is treated as a free variable, while the follower's is determined via inverse kinematics to satisfy the constraint. We extensively evaluate the method in simulation across diverse environments, constraints and bimanual platforms, achieving 19.4x faster planning than prior work while guaranteeing continuous constraint satisfaction. Real-world experiments on a bimanual Kinova Gen3 setup, involving tray transport and elongated-object manipulation, validate direct transfer of planned trajectories to physical hardware.
tldr: This paper presents a fast bimanual motion planning pipeline that enforces a hard relative transformation constraint via a leader-follower parameterization, achieving 19.4x speedup over prior work with real-world validation on a Kinova Gen3 platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种快速双臂运动规划管线，通过主从参数化强制执行刚性相对变换约束，在真实平台上实现比先前工作快19.4倍的规划速度，并验证了实物部署。
summary_zh: 双臂操作能够实现复杂任务，但由于涉及大量自由度，也带来了额外的复杂性。在操作刚性物体时，两个末端执行器之间的相对变换必须在整个运动过程中保持固定，这表现为一个非线性等式约束，将可行构型空间限制在零测度流形上，并对传统运动规划器构成挑战。我们提出了一种快速双臂运动规划流程，该流程沿整个路径持续施加这一刚性变换约束，采用主从参数化方法：将主端构型视为自由变量，从端构型则通过逆运动学求解以满足约束。我们在多种环境、约束条件和双臂平台上对该方法进行了广泛的仿真评估，在保证约束持续满足的前提下，规划速度相比先前工作提升了19.4倍。在Kinova Gen3双臂实验平台上进行的真实实验（包括托盘搬运和细长物体操作）验证了规划轨迹可直接迁移至物理硬件。

title: Graph-Operator World Models for Morphology-Parameter Generalization in Continuous Control
summary: World models for continuous control are commonly trained for a fixed physical system and can degrade when known morphology parameters such as link lengths, masses, damping, and actuation change. Existing approaches often provide these parameters as conditioning information, but leave unspecified which part of the learned transition should remain reusable and which part should change with morphology. We propose Graph-Operator World Models (GraphOp-WM), a structured world model for generalization across unseen morphology parameters within related articulated robot families. GraphOp-WM represents bodies and their kinematic relations as an attributed graph and factorizes each transition into a morphology-independent local dynamics basis and a morphology-conditioned structured operator. The operator combines node-local modulation, kinematic-tree coupling, and a low-rank global correction, while architectural information separation, basis normalization, and paired-morphology supervision encourage static morphology dependence to be carried by the operator pathway. Graph-level readout and edge-wise action representations provide a compatible interface for reward, value, and TD-MPC-style planning. We further define controlled MuJoCo parameter splits covering interpolation, extrapolation, and held-out compositions of link geometry, mass, damping, and actuation parameters in Hopper, Walker2d, and HalfCheetah.
tldr: This paper introduces Graph-Operator World Models (GraphOp-WM), a structured world model that generalizes across unseen morphology parameters in articulated robots by factorizing transitions into a morphology-independent local dynamics basis and a morphology-conditioned operator.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了图算子世界模型（GraphOp-WM），通过将转换分解为形态无关的局部动力学基和形态条件算子，实现对多关节机器人中未见形态参数的泛化。
summary_zh: 摘要：用于连续控制的 World Model 通常针对固定物理系统进行训练，当已知的形态参数（如连杆长度、质量、阻尼和驱动方式）发生变化时，其性能可能会下降。现有方法通常将这些参数作为条件信息提供，但未明确指定学习到的转移模型中哪些部分应保持可复用、哪些部分应随形态变化。我们提出图算子 World Model（GraphOp-WM），这是一种结构化世界模型，能够泛化至相关铰接机器人族内未见过的形态参数。GraphOp-WM 将机器人本体及其运动学关系表示为属性图，并将每次转移分解为与形态无关的局部动力学基函数和一个受形态条件约束的结构化算子。该算子结合了节点局部调制、运动学树耦合以及低秩全局修正，同时通过架构信息分离、基函数归一化和配对形态监督，促使静态形态依赖性由算子通路承载。图级读出与边级动作表示为奖励、价值函数及基于 TD-MPC 的规划提供了兼容接口。我们进一步定义了受控的 MuJoCo 参数划分，涵盖 Hopper、Walker2d 和 HalfCheetah 中连杆几何、质量、阻尼和驱动参数的插值、外推及留出组合。

title: A Collaborative Multi-Modality Interaction for VLA-based End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving by jointly integrating perception, reasoning, and decision making within a unified multimodal framework. However, most existing VLA models formulate end-to-end autonomous driving as a visual question answering task, leading to unreliable and less interpretable decision reasoning. In addition, they fail to establish effective multi-modal interaction across heterogeneous sensors, thereby limiting robust scene perception and reliable driving reasoning in long-tail driving scenarios. To this end, we propose a robust VLA-based end-to-end autonomous driving system that combines multi-modality interaction with multi-trajectory planning and optimization, enabling more reliable, interpretable, and safer driving decisions. Our method comprises three core components: (1) Affinity-Guided Optimal Transport for main-auxiliary modality two-way interaction; (2) Distribution-Consistent Modality Transfer for heterogeneous modality distribution transfer and cross-modal interaction; (3) Multi-modal Multi-Trajectory Planning along with Perception-Oriented Trajectory Refinement for better driving decisions to long-tail driving scenarios. Experimental results in open-loop and closed-loop datasets demonstrate improvements in safety long-horizon driving reasoning and road scene perception over existing driving systems, highlighting the ability of our mutli-modality interaction and multi-trajectory planning and optimization for scalable VLA-based systems.
tldr: Proposes a VLA-based end-to-end autonomous driving system with multi-modality interaction, multi-trajectory planning, and optimization for interpretable and safe driving decisions in long-tail scenarios.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于VLA的端到端自动驾驶系统，通过多模态交互、多轨迹规划和优化，在长尾场景中实现可解释和安全的驾驶决策。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将感知、推理与决策集成于统一的多模态框架中，已成为端到端自动驾驶的强大范式。然而，现有大多数VLA模型将端到端自动驾驶建模为视觉问答任务，导致决策推理不可靠且可解释性不足。此外，它们未能建立跨异构传感器的有效多模态交互，从而限制了在长尾驾驶场景中的鲁棒场景感知与可靠驾驶推理。为此，本文提出一种基于VLA的鲁棒端到端自动驾驶系统，该系统将多模态交互与多轨迹规划及优化相结合，可实现更可靠、可解释且更安全的驾驶决策。本方法包含三个核心组件：（1）基于亲和力引导最优传输的主-辅助模态双向交互模块；（2）面向分布一致性模态迁移的异构模态分布迁移与跨模态交互模块；（3）面向感知驱动轨迹优化的多模态多轨迹规划模块，以改善长尾驾驶场景的决策质量。在开环与闭环数据集上的实验结果表明，相较于现有驾驶系统，本方法在安全长时域驾驶推理与道路场景感知方面均取得显著提升，验证了多模态交互与多轨迹规划优化机制对可扩展VLA系统的支撑能力。

title: Multi-Modal Traffic Sign Detection with Semantic Attributes for Autonomous Driving
summary: Reliable traffic sign detection is a prerequisite for the global deployment of autonomous driving systems, where regulatory compliance and road safety depend on perceiving signs correctly across regions, ranges, and weather conditions. Despite recent progress, vision-based methods continue to face three fundamental limitations: poor cross-regional generalization due to high diversity across countries, degraded performance on small-object detection at long ranges (traffic signs occupy as little as $10{\times}10$ pixels at 200m), and fragile temporal tracking under the strongly non-linear perspective distortion that occurs as a vehicle approaches a sign. In this paper, we address the problem of robust, long-range, region-agnostic traffic sign perception by combining camera and Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensing. We present a multi-modal detection framework whose Intensity-Aware Deformable Fusion module aligns retro-reflective LiDAR cues with camera features, anchoring detection on geometric invariants rather than region-specific visual appearance. We further introduce a dual motion-model tracker that explicitly accounts for non-linear perspective transformations during vehicle approach, substantially improving temporal consistency over linear motion assumptions. Additionally, we develop a semantic attribute classification pipeline that estimates occlusion level, readability, sign embeddedness, and road relevance, providing actionable context to downstream planning. Extensive evaluation on our dataset, spanning 60+ countries and 2,500+ hours of driving data, shows that the proposed pipeline achieves an Object Miss Ratio (OMR) of 0.49% across 221,068 evaluation sequences, demonstrating globally generalizable traffic sign perception in commercial-grade autonomous driving systems.
tldr: A multi-modal traffic sign detection framework that fuses LiDAR retro-reflective cues with camera features and uses a dual motion-model tracker for robust long-range detection across diverse regions.
tldr_zh: 一种融合激光雷达反光线索与相机特征的多模态交通标志检测框架，并采用双运动模型跟踪器实现跨区域的稳健远距离检测。
summary_zh: 可靠的交通标志检测是自动驾驶系统全球部署的前提条件，其合规性与道路安全性取决于能否在不同区域、距离及天气条件下准确识别标志。尽管近年来取得了进展，基于视觉的方法仍面临三个基本限制：因各国标志高度多样性导致的跨区域泛化能力差；远距离小目标检测性能下降（交通标志在200米处仅占$10{\times}10$像素）；以及车辆靠近标志时因强非线性透视畸变造成的时序跟踪不稳定。本文通过融合摄像头与激光雷达（LiDAR）感知，解决鲁棒、远距离、区域无关的交通标志感知问题。我们提出一种多模态检测框架，其强度感知变形融合模块将LiDAR的逆反射特征与摄像头特征对齐，使检测锚定于几何不变量而非区域特定的视觉外观。进一步引入双运动模型跟踪器，显式处理车辆靠近过程中的非线性透视变换，显著改善了基于线性运动假设的时序一致性。此外，我们开发了语义属性分类流水线，用于估计遮挡程度、可读性、标志嵌入状态及道路关联性，为下游规划提供可操作的上下文信息。在我们涵盖60余个国家、2500余小时驾驶数据的数据集上的广泛评估表明，该流水线在221068个评估序列上实现了0.49%的目标漏检率（OMR），验证了其在商业级自动驾驶系统中实现全球泛化交通标志感知的能力。

title: Demonstration-Guided Humanoid Stand-Up on an Emulated Deformable Surface
summary: This paper presents a reference-guided reinforcement learning framework to generate stand-up motion for a 29-DOF Unitree G1 humanoid on deformable soft ground, using a human demonstration recorded on hard ground. The terrain compliance is modelled using solref and solimp parameters from MuJoCo's rigid body soft-contact model. The rewards consists of (i) reference motion tracking through residual joint-position control and (ii) explicit recovery objectives such as pelvis height, torso uprightness, and the final posture. First, the policy is trained with the specified rewards considering hard ground. Next, the terrain stiffness is lowered by updating solref and the nominal surface penetration zone is expanded using solimp. Subsequent training enables the policy to adapt to the delayed support force generation due to significant surface penetration during contact-intensive phases while preserving the original demonstration pattern. The learned policy successfully completes the fallen-to-standing task in simulation, reaching the targeted pelvis height and uprightness, with a maximum contact penetration of approximately 40 mm during the process. The proposed method is demonstrated on two stand-up sequences and successfully achieves the final recovery objective on both hard and soft ground. Ablation studies show that reference tracking alone is insufficient for successful stand-up, and that explicit recovery rewards are essential.
tldr: A reference-guided RL framework that transfers human stand-up demonstrations from hard to soft ground for a 29-DOF humanoid robot, using MuJoCo soft-contact parameters to model terrain compliance.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于参考引导的强化学习框架，将人类从硬地面站立的演示迁移到软地面，用于29自由度人形机器人，通过MuJoCo软接触参数建模地形柔顺性。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种参考引导的强化学习框架，用于在可变形软地面上生成29自由度Unitree G1人形机器人的站立动作，该框架利用了在硬地面上记录的人类演示。地面柔顺性通过MuJoCo刚体软接触模型中的solref与solimp参数进行建模。奖励函数包括：（i）通过残差关节位置控制实现的参考动作跟踪，以及（ii）显式恢复目标——如骨盆高度、躯干竖直度及最终姿态。首先，在考虑硬地面的情况下，使用指定奖励训练策略。随后，通过更新solref降低地形刚度，并利用solimp扩展标称表面穿透区域。后续训练使策略能够适应接触密集阶段因显著表面穿透所导致的支撑力延迟生成，同时保留原始演示模式。学习到的策略在仿真中成功完成了从倒地到站立的任务，达到了目标骨盆高度与竖直度，过程中最大接触穿透深度约为40毫米。所提方法在两个站立序列上进行了验证，并在硬地面与软地面上均成功实现了最终恢复目标。消融研究表明，仅依赖参考跟踪不足以实现成功站立，显式恢复奖励至关重要。

title: Natural Sit-to-Stand Motion Synthesis For Humanoids via Guided Assistance Curricula and Staged Rewards
summary: A humanoid has infinitely many ways to stand up from sitting while maintaining balance, making sit-to-stand (STS) a challenging control problem. We synthesise natural humanoid STS motion from scratch using reinforcement learning, without demonstrations or reference trajectories. A single Proximal Policy Optimisation policy learns smooth, human-like rising driven by three complementary components. (i) A coupled force/chair-height curriculum is used. A vertical pelvis-assist force aids early trajectory exploration and decays over training. Taller chairs are unlocked with decaying assisting force. This ensures that the policy masters a viable STS trajectory at each chair height before being exposed to harder ones, avoiding the premature distribution shift that otherwise collapses generalisation. (ii) Motion robustness is achieved by randomly sampling from a large number of inverse kinematics-generated initial and target poses spanning over eight chair heights. (iii) A set of rewards is defined inspired from biomechanics and optimal control studies. They shape the robot's angular momentum for seat-off, and enable support-region transition via centre of pressure attraction function to ensure smooth low-effort actuation. On a deterministic force-free evaluator, the policy attains more than 97% balanced-standing success across eight chair heights. The policy generalises smooth motion across chair heights and enables the robot to rise from substantially deep-seated postures as compared to the state of the art.
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning method for natural humanoid sit-to-stand motion synthesis without demonstrations, using a coupled force/chair-height curriculum and biomechanics-inspired rewards.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需示范的强化学习方法，通过耦合的力/椅子高度课程和生物力学启发的奖励，合成自然的类人机器人从坐到站的运动。
summary_zh: 人形机器人从坐姿到站姿的平衡控制存在无限多种可能，这使得坐-站转换（STS）成为一项具有挑战性的控制问题。我们利用强化学习从零开始合成自然的人形机器人STS动作，无需演示或参考轨迹。单个近端策略优化算法通过三个互补组件驱动，学习到平滑且类人的起身动作：（i）采用力/椅高耦合课程学习策略。垂直骨盆辅助力有助于早期轨迹探索，并随训练过程逐渐衰减；同时，随着辅助力衰减，解锁更高座椅高度的训练任务。这确保策略在接触更难任务前，已在各座椅高度掌握可行的STS轨迹，避免了泛化能力退化过早分布偏移的问题。（ii）通过从涵盖八种座椅高度的运动学逆解生成的初始位姿与目标位姿中随机采样，实现运动鲁棒性。（iii）受生物力学与最优控制研究启发，定义一组奖励函数。这些函数可调节机器人离座时的角动量，并通过压力中心吸引函数实现支撑区域转换，确保低能耗平滑驱动。在确定性的无外力评估系统中，该策略在八种座椅高度下均达到97%以上的平衡站立成功率。与现有技术相比，该策略不仅能跨座椅高度泛化平滑动作，还使机器人能够从深度坐姿状态下成功起身。

title: GhostTac: Manipulating Tactile Sensors without Physical Contact
summary: Tactile sensors are integral to modern robotic systems, enabling robots to perceive and interact with the physical environment through tactile feedback. However, the physical-layer security of tactile sensors has received little attention. We present GhostTac, the first contactless attack, to the best of our knowledge, that manipulates tactile sensing through electromagnetic interference (EMI). GhostTac exploits nonlinear rectification and limited-bandwidth amplification, converting carefully crafted EMI signals into persistent DC offsets that bypass onboard filtering and induce stable measurement deviations. It enables fine-grained, controllable manipulation of sensor outputs by shaping the spatial distribution and magnitude of interference at targeted locations. Such manipulation can induce harmful robot behaviors, including excessive force that may damage objects or injure people. We evaluate GhostTac on 10 sensor modules and two dexterous hands, covering 15 tactile sensors of different types, and demonstrate consistent effectiveness across all tested devices. Three case studies involving tactile grasping, slip detection, and material classification further illustrate its practical impact on real robotic tasks. These findings reveal a new physical attack vector against tactile sensing in robotic systems.
tldr: GhostTac demonstrates the first contactless attack on tactile sensors using electromagnetic interference to induce false readings, which can cause robots to apply excessive force and compromise safety.
tldr_zh: GhostTac 展示了首个通过电磁干扰对触觉传感器进行非接触式攻击的方法，可诱导错误读数，导致机器人施加过大力量并危及安全。
summary_zh: 触觉传感器是现代机器人系统的重要组成部分，使机器人能够通过触觉反馈感知并与物理环境交互。然而，触觉传感器的物理层安全性尚未得到充分关注。本文提出GhostTac——据我们所知，这是首个通过电磁干扰操纵触觉感知的非接触式攻击方法。GhostTac利用非线性整流与有限带宽放大特性，将精心设计的电磁干扰信号转换为持续的直流偏置电压，从而绕过板载滤波电路并引发稳定的测量偏差。通过控制目标位置的干扰空间分布与强度，该方法可对传感器输出进行细粒度可操控的干预。此类干预可能引发机器人有害行为，例如施加可能损坏物体或伤人的过度力。我们在10个传感器模块和两只灵巧手上对GhostTac进行了评估，涵盖15个不同类型触觉传感器，所有被测设备均表现出稳定有效性。涉及触觉抓取、滑觉检测和材料分类的三个案例研究进一步揭示了该方法对真实机器人任务的实际影响。这些发现为机器人系统中触觉感知的安全研究揭示了一种新型物理攻击途径。

title: ForeTime-VLA: Causal Future-Token Distillation from a World Action Model for Conveyor-Belt Manipulation
summary: Manipulating moving objects requires a policy to anticipate contact events, yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies are commonly fine-tuned from the current observation alone. World action models (WAMs) learn predictive dynamics, but running a video-scale teacher or explicitly imagining future frames at deployment is costly. We introduce ForeTime-VLA, a dense pi0.5 policy that distills a future-aware, action-equivalent representation from a frozen Fast-WAM-derived teacher while remaining causal at inference. Offline, current and future video latents are compressed into a whitened 64-D target. Online, an eight-frame history encoder predicts this target together with manipulation phase and normalized time-to-transition. Four future tokens and one phase token condition the VLM prefix, while the predicted future and transition horizon condition the action expert. Training retains the original flow-matching action target and adds cosine, relational geometry, phase, time-to-transition, and action-equivalence objectives. On a deduplicated conveyor-belt dataset, we compare 40k-step checkpoints on 768 matched windows per split. Test MAE decreases from 0.134119 to 0.130593 (2.63%; paired-bootstrap 95% CI: 0.82-4.48% improvement), and test L2 decreases by 3.02%, at a 2.46-2.93% latency cost. In quantitative real-robot evaluation, ForeTime-VLA achieves 81.1% stationary and 58.9% slow-moving grasp success, exceeding the next-best reference by 12.2 and 22.2 percentage points, respectively. Across three belt speeds, it completes 44/90 grasps versus 23/90 for pi0.5, including 11/30 versus 2/30 at fast speed. The agreement between offline orientation gains and reduced real-robot contact-pose failures supports causal future-token distillation as an effective way to improve dynamic manipulation without deploying the world-model teacher.
tldr: ForeTime-VLA distills future-aware representations from a frozen world action model into a causal VLA policy, significantly improving dynamic conveyor-belt grasping without needing video-scale inference at deployment.
tldr_zh: ForeTime-VLA 从冻结的世界动作模型中蒸馏出未来感知的因果表示到 VLA 策略中，显著提升了传送带动态抓取性能，且无需在部署时进行视频级推理。
summary_zh: 操纵移动物体需要一种能够预判接触事件的策略，然而视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常仅基于当前观测进行微调。世界动作模型（WAM）可以学习预测性动力学，但在部署时运行视频规模的教师模型或显式想象未来帧的成本过高。我们提出ForeTime-VLA——一种密集型的pi0.5策略，该策略从冻结的Fast-WAM衍生教师模型中蒸馏出具有未来感知能力的动作等表征，同时在推理阶段保持因果性。在离线阶段，当前与未来的视频潜变量被压缩为白化后的64维目标。在线阶段，一个八帧历史编码器预测该目标，同时预测操作阶段和归一化的转移时间。四个未来token和一个阶段token对VLM前缀进行条件约束，而预测的未来与转移时域则对动作专家进行条件约束。训练过程保留原始流匹配动作目标，并新增余弦、关系几何、阶段、转移时间及动作等致性目标。在去重传送带数据集上，我们在每个分区的768个匹配窗口中比较了40k步检查点。测试MAE从0.134119降至0.130593（降低2.63%；配对自举95%置信区间：0.82-4.48%改进），测试L2降低3.02%，代价为2.46-2.93%的延迟增加。在定量真实机器人评估中，ForeTime-VLA在静止和慢速移动抓取任务中分别达到81.1%和58.9%的成功率，较次优参考方法分别提升12.2和22.2个百分点。在三种传送带速度下，其完成44/90次抓取（对比pi0.5的23/90），其中快速档位达成11/30次（对比2/30）。离线方向性增益与真实机器人接触姿态失败减少的一致性，证实了因果未来token蒸馏是无需部署世界模型教师即可提升动态操控性能的有效途径。

title: CoAnchor: Robust Collaborative Perception under Spatio-Temporal Misalignment via Object-Level Anchors
summary: Collaborative perception extends the sensing range of a single vehicle by fusing observations from nearby agents, which improves the robustness of autonomous driving. In realistic deployments, however, the received collaborator messages are often affected by both communication delay and relative-pose noise, which jointly cause stale observations, spatial misalignment, and unstable feature fusion. Existing methods usually address these issues from either the spatial or temporal side, but handling them jointly in a unified and efficient manner remains challenging. In this paper, we propose CoAnchor, an anchor-centric spatio-temporal alignment framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Instead of directly reasoning on dense BEV features, CoAnchor builds sparse object-level spatio-temporal anchors as a shared interface for pose correction and tightly connects spatial refinement, temporal propagation, and current-time verification within one unified loop, while keeping the overall correction process lightweight. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets illustrate that CoAnchor remains competitive under clean settings and improves the robustness under joint delay and pose perturbations with a favorable practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
tldr: CoAnchor proposes a lightweight, object-level anchor framework that jointly corrects spatial and temporal misalignment in collaborative perception for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: CoAnchor 提出了一种轻量级的、以对象级锚点为核心的框架，用于联合校正协作感知中的空间和时间错位。
summary_zh: 协作感知通过融合邻近智能体的观测数据，扩展了单一车辆的感知范围，从而提升了自动驾驶的鲁棒性。然而，在实际部署中，接收到的协作消息常同时受到通信延迟和相对姿态噪声的影响，导致观测信息过时、空间对齐偏差以及特征融合不稳定。现有方法通常分别从空间或时间维度解决这些问题，但如何在统一且高效的框架中联合处理两者仍具挑战。本文提出CoAnchor——一种面向异步协作感知的以锚点为中心的时空对齐框架。不同于直接处理密集的鸟瞰图特征，CoAnchor构建了稀疏的物体级时空锚点作为姿态校正的共享接口，并将空间精化、时间传播与当前时刻验证紧密耦合于统一循环中，同时保持整体校正过程的轻量化。在模拟与真实数据集上的大量实验表明，CoAnchor在理想条件下保持竞争力，并在联合时延与姿态扰动下提升鲁棒性，实现了实际场景中精度与效率的有利平衡。

title: WA-JEPA: Rethinking the Video JEPA Paradigm for World-Action Modeling in Autonomous Driving
summary: Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) learns powerful spatiotemporal representations from video through self-supervised latent feature prediction. However, V-JEPA is built around random-mask completion and deterministic regression, making it fundamentally ill-suited for autonomous driving planning that demands future-directed prediction tightly coupled with action. To address this, we rethink the V-JEPA paradigm and present WA-JEPA, a V-JEPA-native world-action model designed for autonomous driving planning. Instead of random spatiotemporal masking, WA-JEPA employs hybrid future-masked pre-training, where the model infers future latents from observed context. Departing from deterministic regression, we recast future prediction as conditional flow matching over latent futures, which substantially improves the model's ability to generate plausible future latents for downstream planning. Finally, a joint future-action predictor is proposed to denoise future scene tokens and ego trajectories together in a unified spatiotemporal latent space, allowing action supervision to directly shape planning-relevant world representations. Pre-trained on nuPlan videos and fine-tuned on NAVSIM, WA-JEPA reaches 91.7 EPDMS on NAVSIM-v2, surpassing the strongest end-to-end and world-action baselines by 1.6 and 1.3 EPDMS, and, without HUGSIM-specific fine-tuning, attains the best HD-Score of 0.4462 on the closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark under the same evaluation protocol. These results validate V-JEPA-native world-action modeling as a powerful and scalable paradigm for autonomous driving planning. Code is available at https://github.com/AFARI-Research/WA-JEPA.
tldr: This paper introduces WA-JEPA, a world-action model for autonomous driving planning that adapts the Video JEPA framework by replacing random masking with future-masked pre-training and deterministic regression with conditional flow matching, achieving state-of-the-art results on NAVSIM and HUGSIM benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出WA-JEPA，一种用于自动驾驶规划的世界-动作模型，通过将Video JEPA框架中的随机掩码替换为未来掩码预训练、将确定性回归替换为条件流匹配，在NAVSIM和HUGSIM基准上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 视频联合嵌入预测架构（V-JEPA）通过自监督潜在特征预测，从视频中学习强大的时空表征。然而，V-JEPA 基于随机掩码补全与确定性回归构建，使其从根本上不适合要求未来导向预测与动作紧密耦合的自动驾驶规划。为解决这一问题，我们重新思考 V-JEPA 范式，提出 WA-JEPA——一种专为自动驾驶规划设计的 V-JEPA 原生世界-动作模型。与随机时空掩码不同，WA-JEPA 采用混合未来掩码预训练，模型从观测到的上下文中推断未来潜在特征。不同于确定性回归，我们将未来预测重新定义为潜在未来上的条件流匹配，这显著提升了模型为下游规划生成合理未来潜在特征的能力。最后，我们提出一种联合未来-动作预测器，在统一的时空潜在空间中共同去噪未来场景令牌与自车轨迹，使动作监督能够直接塑造与规划相关的世界表征。在 nuPlan 视频上预训练并在 NAVSIM 上微调后，WA-JEPA 在 NAVSIM-v2 上达到 91.7 EPDMS，分别超越最强的端到端基线和世界-动作基线 1.6 和 1.3 EPDMS；并且，在无需针对 HUGSIM 进行特定微调的情况下，在相同评估协议下的闭环 HUGSIM 基准上取得了最佳 HD-Score 0.4462。这些结果验证了 V-JEPA 原生世界-动作建模作为自动驾驶规划的一种强大且可扩展的范式。代码开源于 https://github.com/AFARI-Research/WA-JEPA。

title: CertVLA: Certified Defense against Physical Visual Attacks for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are vulnerable to localized physical perturbations, yet existing certified patch defenses target discrete labels and cannot directly certify continuous, temporally correlated actions. We introduce CertVLA, a certified defense for closed-loop VLA control under bounded patch and texture attacks. CertVLA proposes a calibrated region of behaviorally consistent actions, while deterministic covering masks ensure that at least one checked prediction is attack-free. Specifically, CertVLA normalizes action disagreement by the benign variation of each mask pair and accepts a single-mask anchor only when it remains consistent under every second mask. It then calibrates the resulting max-min-max episode score to provide finite-sample clean coverage. Conjoining query-level decisions extends the action certificate to the complete closed-loop rollout. Furthermore, we prove that against any adaptive attacker satisfying the bounded-support threat model, every rollout certified by CertVLA executes only action chunks consistent with attack-erased clean predictions. Under dual-mask rollout correctness, this consistency certificate further guarantees task success. The certificate is independent of patch content, generation method, and physical transformation. Experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the empirical and certified effectiveness of CertVLA against patch attacks, with additional simulation validation on texture attacks.
tldr: CertVLA provides the first certified defense against physical patch and texture attacks for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, guaranteeing consistent closed-loop control actions under bounded perturbations.
tldr_zh: CertVLA 是首个针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在物理补丁和纹理攻击下的认证防御方法，保证在有限扰动下闭环控制动作的一致性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略易受局部物理扰动的攻击，然而现有经过认证的补丁防御方法针对的是离散标签，无法直接对连续的、具有时序相关性的动作进行认证。我们提出CertVLA，一种针对有界补丁和纹理攻击下闭环VLA控制的认证防御方法。CertVLA提出一种经校准的行为一致性动作区域，同时确定性覆盖掩码确保至少有一个被检测的预测不受攻击影响。具体而言，CertVLA通过每个掩码对的良性变化对动作不一致性进行归一化，并仅在单个掩码锚点在所有第二掩码下均保持一致时才接受该锚点。随后，它对得到的最大-最小-最大回合分数进行校准，以提供有限样本的干净覆盖率。将查询级决策相结合，可将动作认证扩展至完整的闭环展开。此外，我们证明：对于任何满足有界支撑威胁模型的自适应攻击者，经CertVLA认证的每次展开仅执行与攻击消除后的干净预测一致的动作片段。在双掩码展开正确性条件下，该一致性认证可进一步保证任务成功。该认证独立于补丁内容、生成方法和物理变换。仿真和真实世界实验展示了CertVLA在应对补丁攻击时的经验有效性与认证有效性，并在纹理攻击上提供了额外的仿真验证。

title: NeSAM: Neuro-Symbolic Kinodynamics with Soil Adaptation for Off-Road Mobility
summary: Accurate prediction of off-road vehicle motion over deformable terrain remains challenging because sinkage, slip, and traction vary with local soil conditions. Existing learning-based kinodynamic models directly approximate vehicle-terrain interactions from data but do not explicitly represent soil mechanics and offer limited physical interpretability. To address these limitations, we present NeSAM, a neuro-symbolic framework that combines differentiable Bekker-Wong terramechanics with learned terrain representations and a Transformer-based residual dynamics model for long-horizon, six degree-of-freedom kinodynamic prediction. The terramechanics component models soil-dependent interaction forces, while the residual model corrects discrepancies between the analytical prediction and the observed vehicle dynamics. NeSAM further estimates physically meaningful soil parameters from terrain observations and updates them online using an extended Kalman filter. We evaluate NeSAM in Verti-Bench, a simulator built on the Chrono multiphysics engine, and validate its performance on a physical Verti-4-Wheeler platform. NeSAM improves prediction accuracy by up to 30% in simulation and 29% on real-world data relative to the strongest compared baselines. When integrated with a close-loop navigation controller, NeSAM further improves traversal success rate through online soil adaptation while reduces Hausdorff distance to the reference trajectory by 69.4%, indicating improved trajectory tracking accuracy.
tldr: A neuro-symbolic framework combining differentiable terramechanics with learned residual dynamics for off-road kinodynamic prediction, enabling online soil adaptation and improved trajectory tracking on real and simulated robots.
tldr_zh: 一个结合可微分轮地力学与学习残差动力学的神经符号框架，用于越野运动学动力学预测，实现在线和土壤适应，在实际机器人平台上提升轨迹跟踪精度。
summary_zh: 在可变形地形上准确预测越野车辆运动仍具有挑战性，因为下陷量、滑转率和牵引力会随局部土壤条件变化。现有的基于学习的运动动力学模型直接从数据中近似车辆-地形相互作用，但未显式表示土壤力学特性，且物理可解释性有限。为解决这些局限性，我们提出NeSAM——一种神经符号框架，将可微分的Bekker-Wong地面力学模型与学习到的地形表征以及基于Transformer的残差动力学模型相结合，用于长时域、六自由度的运动动力学预测。地面力学组件模拟与土壤相关的相互作用力，而残差模型则校正分析预测与观测车辆动力学之间的偏差。NeSAM进一步从地形观测中估计具有物理意义的土壤参数，并通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器在线更新这些参数。我们在基于Chrono多物理场引擎构建的仿真器Verti-Bench中评估NeSAM，并在物理Verti-四轮车平台上验证其性能。与最强基线方法相比，NeSAM在仿真中将预测精度提升高达30%，在真实数据上提升29%。当与闭环导航控制器集成时，NeSAM通过在线土壤自适应将通行成功率进一步提高，同时将参考轨迹的豪斯多夫距离降低69.4%，表明轨迹跟踪精度得到改善。

title: TaPeR: Probabilistic Recovery of Sparse Task Precedence Graphs from a Handful of Demonstrations
summary: Long-horizon manipulation tasks are often only partially ordered. For example, when assembling an electronic device, the battery and circuit board may be installed in either order, but both must be in place before the enclosure is closed. Recovering such dependencies enables robots to flexibly reorder subtasks while preserving task validity. Existing approaches typically infer task structure from human demonstrations using both temporal and symbolic supervision. However, symbolic predicates require explicit grounding, which is difficult to obtain in realistic settings. In this work, we present an approach for extracting task dependency structures from demonstrations using only simple kinematic graphs and distributions over relative object poses. From these representations, our method estimates pairwise task-step-dependency probabilities and uses them to initialize the edge weights of a precedence graph. We then introduce a filtering pipeline that converts this graph of probability estimates into the final task dependency graph. We evaluate our approach on an existing benchmark and on a new dataset comprising longer tasks with more complex dependencies. We find that our method recovers more accurate task structures from fewer demonstrations than the baselines. Finally, we demonstrate that the inferred graphs can be used to generate multiple valid robotic execution orders for the same task.
tldr: TaPeR extracts sparse task precedence graphs from few demonstrations using kinematic graphs and object pose distributions, enabling robots to generate valid execution orders for long-horizon manipulation.
tldr_zh: TaPeR通过运动学图和物体位姿分布，从少量演示中提取稀疏任务优先图，使机器人能够为长时程操作生成有效的执行顺序。
summary_zh: 面向长时域操作任务往往仅具备部分有序性。例如，在组装电子设备时，电池与电路板的安装顺序可以互换，但两者均需在闭合外壳前就位。恢复此类依赖关系能够使机器人在保持任务有效性的前提下灵活重排子任务顺序。现有方法通常通过结合时序监督与符号监督从人类示教中推断任务结构。然而，符号谓词需要显式具身化，这在现实场景中难以实现。本研究提出一种仅利用简单运动学图谱和物体相对位姿分布来提取任务依赖结构的方法。该方法通过上述表征估计成对任务步骤的依赖概率，并以此初始化前序图的边权重。随后我们引入过滤管线，将概率估计图转化为最终的任务依赖图。我们在现有基准测试及包含更长任务与更复杂依赖关系的新数据集上评估了该方法。实验表明，与基线方法相比，本方法能从更少的示教中恢复更准确的任务结构。最后，我们验证了推断出的依赖图可用于为同一任务生成多种有效的机器人执行顺序。

title: PhysCaP: Grounding Code-as-Policy Agent with Physics-Informed Exploration
summary: We present PhysCaP, a Physics-Informed Code-as-Policy agent for active perception in robotic manipulation. While vision-language-action policies excel at imitating demonstrations, they rely on passive observation and fail to infer latent physical properties critical for manipulation. PhysCaP augments code-as-policy frameworks with a physics-informed exploration layer that enables explicit information-seeking through interaction. It introduces training-free physical property extraction modules that estimate object mass and stiffness from robot proprioception without additional sensors. To balance exploration costs and the efficiency of information obtained, PhysCaP employs a dual-agent design: a Planner that decides when to explore and when to stop, and a Prioritizer that filters implausible interactions and ranks the remainder using a heuristic priority score, enabling efficient, targeted exploration. We evaluate PhysCaP on real-world tabletop manipulation tasks (searching for hidden objects, detecting empty cans, and finding ripe avocados) and a simulated task in LIBERO. The results show that existing passive and naive interactive baselines either fail when physical properties are hidden or over-explore, whereas PhysCaP achieves comparable performance with fewer interactions and reduced execution time. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed physical property extraction modules. Project page: https://physcap.github.io
tldr: PhysCaP augments code-as-policy with physics-informed exploration, enabling robots to estimate object mass/stiffness from proprioception for targeted, efficient manipulation.
tldr_zh: PhysCaP 将代码即策略与物理信息探索相结合，使机器人能够从本体感知中估计物体质量和刚度，从而实现高效、有针对性的操作。
summary_zh: 我们提出了PhysCaP，一种面向机器人操作中主动感知的物理信息驱动型“代码即策略”智能体。尽管视觉-语言-动作策略在模仿演示方面表现出色，但它们依赖于被动观察，无法推断对操作至关重要的潜在物理属性。PhysCaP通过引入物理信息驱动的探索层来增强“代码即策略”框架，使其能够通过交互主动寻求信息。它采用了无需训练的物理属性提取模块，无需额外传感器即可从机器人本体感知中估计物体质量与刚度。为平衡探索成本与信息获取效率，PhysCaP采用双智能体设计：规划器（Planner）决定何时探索及何时停止，优先排序器（Prioritizer）过滤不可行的交互，并利用启发式优先级分数对剩余交互进行排序，从而实现高效、有针对性的探索。我们在真实世界的桌面操作任务（搜索隐藏物体、检测空罐子、寻找成熟牛油果）以及LIBERO模拟任务中评估了PhysCaP。结果表明，现有的被动式和简单交互基线要么在物理属性隐藏时失败，要么过度探索，而PhysCaP在更少的交互次数和更短的执行时间内达到了相当的性能。消融研究进一步验证了所提出的物理属性提取模块的有效性。项目页面：https://physcap.github.io

title: Hybrid Roller-Jamming Gripper for Object Acquisition and Retention Under Pose Uncertainty
summary: In household manipulation, pose uncertainty often results in off-centre or partial initial contact, making reliable object acquisition difficult. Roller-based grippers can actively draw objects inward but often provide limited post-capture stability, whereas granular-jamming grippers require sufficient contact before jamming to achieve strong retention. This paper presents a hybrid roller-jamming gripper that integrates active object intake and post-capture retention within a single gripper. The proposed gripper uses inward roller rotation to increase contact and draw the object toward the gripper centre, followed by vacuum-induced granular jamming to stiffen the rollers and stabilise the grasp. The paper also presents a simplified geometric analysis of the gripper and a bench-level characterisation of the prototype's force capability. The gripper prototype was mounted on a 7-DoF robotic arm and evaluated using eight test objects. Furthermore, controlled planar position and orientation offsets were applied, with each condition repeated three times. The main evaluation comprised 840 grasp trials, including 216 planar-offset trials and 624 orientation-offset trials. Overall, the gripper succeeded in 812/840 trials: 215/216 planar-offset trials and 597/624 orientation-offset trials. The ablation evaluation comprised 162 trials on three objects. The roller-only and jamming-only conditions achieved 54/81 and 24/81 successes, respectively, showing their different contributions. These results provide initial mechanism-level evidence that hybrid roller-jamming is a promising strategy for improving acquisition and retention after imperfect first contact.
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid roller-jamming gripper that combines active inward roller rotation for object acquisition with vacuum-induced granular jamming for post-capture retention, demonstrating high success rates under pose uncertainty in real robot trials.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合滚子-颗粒阻塞夹爪，结合主动内旋滚子进行物体抓取和真空诱导颗粒阻塞实现抓取后稳定，在真实机器人实验中展示了高成功率。
summary_zh: 在家庭操作场景中，位姿不确定性常导致抓取时出现偏心或部分接触，使得可靠地获取物体变得困难。基于滚轮的夹爪能主动将物体向内拉拽，但通常难以提供稳定的抓取后保持力；而颗粒阻塞夹爪则需要在阻塞前建立充分接触，才能实现强固的抓取。本文提出一种混合式滚轮阻塞夹爪，在单一夹爪中集成了主动物体吸入与抓取后保持功能。该夹爪通过滚轮向内旋转增加接触面积并将物体拉向夹爪中心，随后通过真空诱导颗粒阻塞使滚轮硬化并稳定抓取。本文还对该夹爪进行了简化几何分析，并对原型机的力性能开展了台架级表征。原型夹爪安装于七自由度机械臂上，使用八个测试对象进行评估。此外，实验引入了受控的平面位置偏移和姿态偏移，每种条件重复三次。主要评估包括840次抓取试验，其中216次平面偏移试验和624次姿态偏移试验。总体而言，夹爪在812/840次试验中成功：平面偏移试验成功215/216次，姿态偏移试验成功597/624次。消融评估在三个物体上进行了162次试验。仅用滚轮和仅用阻塞条件下分别成功54/81次和24/81次，显示出两者不同的贡献机制。这些结果提供了初步的机制层证据，表明混合滚轮阻塞策略是改善首次接触不完美后物体获取与保持能力的一种有前景的方案。

title: Scalable Distributed Simulation-Based Testing for Automated Driving Systems
summary: Virtual scenario-based testing is a key enabler for validating automated driving systems (ADS) and intelligent transport systems (ITS). However, executing large-scale test suites involving possibly thousands of scenarios remains labor-intensive and difficult to scale. This paper presents an end-to-end, DevOps-driven framework that automates build, deployment, and distributed execution of CARLA-based scenario tests of an ADS on a lightweight Kubernetes cluster. ROS 2 applications are packaged as standardized Kubernetes Helm charts generated from repository specifications, while entire simulation environments are composed declaratively via dynamic Helmfile manifests. The paper describes how a distributed testing workflow can be implemented in Argo Workflows to provision environments, aggregate and batch OpenSCENARIO test cases from configurable sources, execute scenarios in parallel across cluster nodes, and collect logs and resource metrics. In an evaluation on a multi-node K3s cluster running 200 scenarios, the best configuration speeds up end-to-end workflow time by more than a factor of eight compared to a sequential baseline. The results demonstrate significant gains in end-to-end execution time and quantify trade-offs between parallelism, orchestration overhead, and cluster stability. The framework is further demonstrated in a real-world ADS test application with connections to scenario sources and downstream evaluation modules. This demonstrates that the approach provides a strong foundation not only for scalable simulation testing, but also for generating traceable evidence that can support safety arguments.
tldr: This paper presents a DevOps-driven framework for distributed, large-scale scenario-based testing of automated driving systems using CARLA, ROS 2, and Kubernetes, achieving significant speedups over sequential execution.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于DevOps的分布式大规模场景测试框架，用于自动化驾驶系统的仿真测试，利用CARLA、ROS 2和Kubernetes实现了相比顺序执行显著的速度提升。
summary_zh: 基于虚拟场景的测试是验证自动驾驶系统（ADS）和智能交通系统（ITS）的关键手段。然而，执行可能包含数千个场景的大规模测试套件仍然劳动密集且难以扩展。本文提出了一种端到端、由DevOps驱动的框架，可在轻量级Kubernetes集群上自动化完成基于CARLA的ADS场景测试的构建、部署与分布式执行。ROS 2应用程序被封装为标准化的Kubernetes Helm Chart（从仓库规范生成），而整个仿真环境则通过动态Helmfile清单以声明方式组合。本文阐述了如何利用Argo Workflows实现分布式测试工作流：配置环境、从可配置源聚合与批处理OpenSCENARIO测试用例、跨集群节点并行执行场景、以及收集日志与资源指标。在一个运行200个场景的多节点K3s集群上的评估显示，与顺序执行的基线相比，最优配置将端到端工作流时间加速了八倍以上。实验结果证明了端到端执行时间的显著改善，并量化了并行度、编排开销与集群稳定性之间的权衡。该框架进一步在真实ADS测试应用中展示，连接了场景源与下游评估模块。这表明该方法不仅为可扩展的仿真测试奠定了坚实基础，也为生成可追溯的证据以支持安全论证提供了有力支撑。

title: Logic-VLA: A Temporal Logic Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can follow natural-language (NL) task instructions, but such instructions may not precisely specify safety-critical or spatiotemporal requirements on the resulting behavior. We introduce Logic-VLA, a formal-requirement-aware VLA that conditions on Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications supplied at inference time. Logic-VLA uses a syntax-graph-based STL encoder pre-trained to capture temporal logic semantics. Policy adaptation proceeds in two stages: STL-conditioned supervised fine-tuning on satisfying demonstrations is followed by trajectory-level preference optimization over matched satisfying-violating rollout pairs using a flow-matching surrogate for Identity Preference Optimization. This formulation improves formal requirement satisfaction while preserving the nominal NL task. We evaluate Logic-VLA in closed-loop quadcopter navigation simulation across randomized photorealistic environments and test generalization to STL formulas unseen during training. Across the evaluation benchmarks, Logic-VLA improves STL satisfaction rate over an STL-blind base policy by 24.8 to 40.7 percentage points (pp) while reducing nominal NL task success by at most 1.8 pp, showing that a single VLA can adapt its behavior to varying formal requirements without requiring a separate policy for each specification.
tldr: Logic-VLA introduces a temporal-logic-conditioned VLA model that uses STL specifications to enforce formal spatiotemporal requirements, improving STL satisfaction by up to 40.7 pp while minimally degrading NL instruction following in quadcopter navigation.
tldr_zh: Logic-VLA 提出了一种基于时态逻辑条件的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过 STL 规范施加形式化时空需求，在四旋翼导航中将 STL 满足率提升最多 40.7 个百分点，同时自然语言指令的成功率仅下降最多 1.8 个百分点。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够遵循自然语言（NL）任务指令，但此类指令可能无法精确指定行为结果中涉及安全关键或时空约束的要求。我们提出Logic-VLA，一种基于形式化需求感知的VLA模型，其行为条件依赖于推理时提供的信号时序逻辑（STL）规范。Logic-VLA采用基于语法图的STL编码器，该编码器经过预训练以捕获时序逻辑语义。策略适应分为两个阶段：首先在满足条件的演示数据上进行STL条件监督微调，然后使用流匹配代理进行身份偏好优化，对满足-违反成对的轨迹数据进行轨迹级偏好优化。这种设计在保持自然语言任务执行能力的同时，提升了形式化需求的满足程度。我们在随机化逼真环境中对四旋翼无人机闭环导航仿真进行了评估，并测试了对训练中未见STL公式的泛化能力。在各项评估基准中，Logic-VLA相较于不感知STL的基础策略，将STL满足率提升了24.8至40.7个百分点，同时自然语言任务成功率最多仅下降1.8个百分点。这表明单个VLA模型能够适应不同的形式化需求调整其行为，无需为每个规范单独训练策略。

title: Koala Gripper: Co-designing Robotic Grippers and Data-Capture Devices for Scaling Dexterous Manipulation Learning
summary: As the demand for larger manipulation datasets grows, handheld robotic gripper data collection and the associated gripper designs become more vital. Current data collection device designs trend towards matching the morphologies of existing robotic grippers, sacrificing ergonomics and manipulation performance. In this paper, we propose a co-design framework that guides the simultaneous development of both data collection and robotic execution devices by weaving both platform constraints into the design process. Through this workflow, we present the Koala Gripper system, a data capture device and robotic gripper platform that improves dexterity and grasp capability compared to parallel jaw grippers while preserving scalability and ease-of-use. The design introduces a novel force-optimized finger/trigger linkage mechanism with directional reflected mass characteristics, a unique monolithic dual-thumb, and user-centered ergonomic design. The design's actuated robotic fingers are backdrivable, with effective mass on the order of tens of grams. We show that these grippers are capable of secure grasps over a wide range of objects, forceful tool use, and precise singulation. We further validate the platform by deploying it with an end-to-end data collection and policy execution pipeline that highlights its capabilities through learning from demonstration. More information available at http://koalagripper.rai-inst.com
tldr: This paper presents a co-design framework for simultaneously developing a handheld data-capture device and a robotic gripper, resulting in the Koala Gripper system that improves dexterity and grasping capability while preserving scalability and ease-of-use for large-scale manipulation data collection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种共设计框架，同时开发手持数据采集设备和机器人夹爪，得到了Koala Gripper系统，在保持可扩展性和易用性的同时提高了灵巧性和抓取能力，用于大规模操作数据收集。
summary_zh: 随着对大规模操作数据集需求的增长，手持式机械抓取器数据采集及其相关抓取器设计变得愈发重要。当前数据采集设备的设计趋势倾向于模仿现有机械抓取器的形态，但牺牲了人机工程学和操作性能。本文提出一种协同设计框架，通过将两种平台约束融入设计流程，引导数据采集设备与机器人执行装置的同步开发。基于该工作流，我们提出了考拉抓取器系统——一种数据采集装置与机器人抓取器平台，相较于平行夹爪抓取器，该系统在提升灵巧性和抓取能力的同时，保持了可扩展性与易用性。该设计引入了一种创新的力优化手指/触发器连杆机构，具有定向反射质量特性、独特的一体式双拇指结构以及以用户为中心的人体工学设计。其驱动式机器人手指具备反向驱动能力，有效质量控制在数十克量级。实验证明，该抓取器能够实现对多种物体的可靠抓取、强力的工具操作以及精准的单指分离操作。我们通过端到端的数据采集与策略执行流水线进一步验证了该平台，借助示教学习突出了其性能优势。更多信息请访问 http://koalagripper.rai-inst.com

title: EndoLIFT: Language-Disambiguated Latent-Conditioned Rectified Flow for Bidirectional Endoscopic Control
summary: Routine gastrointestinal endoscopy is intrinsically bidirectional: the instrument is advanced to reach target anatomy and later withdrawn or retroflexed for inspection, while an external cue may require earlier reversal. When the requested phase changes before the visual scene does, nearly identical observations can require opposite axial actions. We identify and formalize this ambiguity in bidirectional endoscopic control as intent aliasing. We propose EndoLIFT (Endoscopic Language-Instruction Flow with Trajectory Latents), a vision-language-action policy that combines explicit language-based intent conditioning with a latent-conditioned rectified-flow action expert. The policy receives RGB, a language instruction, and the previous-action state; a 32-D variational trajectory latent stochastically conditions continuous action-chunk generation. Controlled same-observation instruction swaps establish that language selects the axial mode, independently of whether the trajectory latent is present. Relative to the matched model without latent conditioning, EndoLIFT improves navigation-direction accuracy by 11.1 percentage points and reduces wrong-direction advance by 83\%. An architecture-controlled 1-bit mode-flag reference exhibits weaker canonical-anchor switching, while EndoLIFT retains 82.8\% intent-following accuracy across 44 held-out linguistic variants. In closed-loop evaluation, EndoLIFT improves overall success by 30 percentage points over EndoLIFT w/o VTL on both the seen colon phantom and the unseen lung and stomach phantoms, and completes 10/10 ex-vivo porcine-trachea trials. These results separate language-based intent selection from the trajectory latent's contribution to directional correctness and robust retraction.
tldr: EndoLIFT introduces a vision-language-action policy for bidirectional endoscopic control that uses language instructions to resolve intent aliasing when identical visual scenes require opposite actions, and a latent-conditioned rectified-flow expert to generate continuous action chunks.
tldr_zh: EndoLIFT 提出了一种用于双向内窥镜控制的视觉-语言-动作策略，通过语言指令解决相同视觉场景需要相反动作时的意图混淆问题，并利用潜在条件整流流专家生成连续动作块。
summary_zh: 常规胃肠内镜检查本质上是双向的：器械需推进至目标解剖部位，随后回退或翻转以进行检查，而外部提示可能要求提前反转。当指令阶段在视觉场景变化前发生改变时，近乎相同的观察结果可能对应相反的轴向操作。我们将这种双向内镜控制中的歧义性识别并形式化为"意图混叠"。为此提出EndoLIFT（基于内镜语言指令流与轨迹潜变量模型），这是一种融合显式语言意图条件与潜变量条件修正流动作专家的视觉-语言-动作策略。该策略接收RGB图像、语言指令及前一动作状态；32维变分轨迹潜变量随机约束连续动作块生成。可控的相同观测指令交换实验表明：无论轨迹潜变量是否存在，语言均能选择轴向模式。与无潜变量条件的匹配模型相比，EndoLIFT导航方向准确率提升11.1个百分点，错误方向推进减少83%。采用架构控制的1位模式标志参考表现出较弱的规范锚点切换能力，而EndoLIFT在44个保留语言变体测试中保持82.8%的意图遵循准确率。在闭环评估中，EndoLIFT在已见结肠体模及未见肺与胃体模上的总体成功率较无VTL的EndoLIFT提升30个百分点，并在10/10例离体猪气管试验中全部完成。这些结果将基于语言的意图选择与轨迹潜变量对方向正确性及稳健回退的贡献分离开来。

title: Learning-Based Measurement-Robust Control Barrier Functions for Obstacle Avoidance under State Estimation Error
summary: Safety filters are an effective tool for enforcing constraints in safety-critical systems, but most existing methods assume perfect state information, which is rarely available in practice. Recent work has begun to close this gap by developing filtering mechanisms that are robust to state estimation error, but these methods can still exhibit safety violations or overly conservative behavior as estimation error grows. Focusing on obstacle avoidance, we develop two new control barrier function (CBF) formulations: drift-measurement-robust (DMR)-CBFs and neural measurement-robust (NMR)-CBFs. The DMR-CBF augments the standard CBF condition with an inner optimization over the worst-case uncertainty in the drift dynamics, improving robustness to estimation error. This DMR-CBF then supervises a pretraining phase for the NMR-CBF, which replaces the inner optimization with a learned term. The NMR-CBF is subsequently finetuned through differentiable trajectory rollouts, yielding a filter that achieves empirical safety comparable to the DMR-CBF while reducing both conservativeness and computational cost. We provide theoretical analysis of the DMR-CBF along with numerical results on a planar double integrator and a 12D quadrotor, where both proposed approaches prevent collisions while other robust methods either fail or are overly conservative. Finally, we deployed the NMR-CBF on a Unitree Go2, enabling successful navigation of an obstacle field under odometry errors that caused a standard CBF to collide.
tldr: This paper develops drift-measurement-robust (DMR) and neural measurement-robust (NMR) control barrier functions to enable safe obstacle avoidance under state estimation errors, demonstrating theoretical guarantees and real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了漂移测量鲁棒（DMR）和神经测量鲁棒（NMR）控制屏障函数，在状态估计误差下实现安全避障，并在Unitree Go2四足机器人上进行了实际部署验证。
summary_zh: 安全滤波器是在安全关键系统中施加约束的有效工具，但现有方法大多假设完美的状态信息，这在实践中难以实现。近期研究开始通过开发对状态估计误差具有鲁棒性的滤波机制来弥补这一不足，但当估计误差增大时，这些方法仍可能出现违反安全约束或过于保守的行为。针对避障问题，我们提出了两种新的控制障碍函数（CBF）形式：漂移测量鲁棒（DMR）-CBF和神经测量鲁棒（NMR）-CBF。DMR-CBF通过在漂移动力学中对最坏情况不确定性进行内部优化来增强标准CBF条件，从而提升对估计误差的鲁棒性。该DMR-CBF随后监督NMR-CBF的预训练阶段，后者用学习项替代内部优化。通过可微轨迹展开对NMR-CBF进行微调后，所获得的滤波器在经验安全性上可媲美DMR-CBF，同时降低了保守性和计算成本。我们给出了DMR-CBF的理论分析，并在平面双积分器和12维四旋翼飞行器上进行了数值实验——两种方法均能避免碰撞，而其他鲁棒方法要么失效要么过于保守。最后，我们将NMR-CBF部署至Unitree Go2机器人上，在导致标准CBF发生碰撞的里程计误差条件下，成功实现了障碍物场地的导航。

title: A2DINOv3: Rethinking Multi-Modal Object Detection via Socialized Collaboration
summary: Multi-modal object detection is essential for robust scene understanding in challenging conditions, including low-light and adverse environments. Recent vision foundation models (e.g., DINOv3) have exhibited strong representation capabilities, yet adapting them to multi-modal scenarios remains challenging. Existing dense cross-modal fusion strategies often force heterogeneous modalities to interact indiscriminately, which may introduce redundant information and disrupt the valuable pre-trained representations. To address this issue, we revisit multi-modal fusion from the perspective of socialized learning and propose adapter to DINOv3 (A2DINOv3), a multi-expert collaboration framework with a Socialized Collaboration Protocol (SCP). Specifically, RGB and infrared branches are modeled as heterogeneous experts that independently preserve their specialized knowledge while exchanging complementary information through selective and constrained interactions. This design mitigates harmful cross-modal interference and prevents degradation of pre-trained priors during adaptation. Furthermore, a zero-initialization strategy is introduced to gradually activate cross-modal collaboration, enabling a smooth transition from modality-specific learning to cooperative representation learning. Extensive experiments on four multi-modal benchmarks, including aerial detection (GAIIC), autonomous driving (FLIR), low-light surveillance (LLVIP), and diverse real-world scenarios (M3FD), demonstrate that A2DINOv3 consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-modal object detection.
tldr: Proposes a multi-expert collaboration framework with a Socialized Collaboration Protocol to adapt DINOv3 for multi-modal object detection, achieving state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving and other benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种多专家协作框架和社会化协作协议，将DINOv3适配到多模态目标检测中，在自动驾驶等多个基准上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 多模态目标检测对于在低光照、恶劣环境等挑战性条件下实现鲁棒的场景理解至关重要。近年来，视觉基础模型（如DINOv3）展现出强大的表征能力，但将其适配至多模态场景仍面临挑战。现有的密集跨模态融合策略往往强制异质模态进行无差别交互，可能引入冗余信息并破坏有价值的预训练表征。为解决该问题，我们从社会化学习视角重新审视多模态融合，提出适配DINOv3的A2DINOv3框架——一种采用社会化协作协议的多专家协作系统。具体而言，将RGB分支与红外分支建模为异质专家，在保留各自专业知识的同时，通过选择性约束交互交换互补信息。该设计可减轻有害的跨模态干扰，并防止适配过程中预训练先验知识的退化。此外，引入零初始化策略逐步激活跨模态协作，实现从模态特定学习到协同表征学习的平滑过渡。在涵盖航空探测（GAIIC）、自动驾驶（FLIR）、低光照监控（LLVIP）及多样化真实场景（M3FD）的四项多模态基准上的大量实验表明，A2DINOv3在多模态目标检测任务中持续取得最先进性能。

title: SRL-MPC: Shape-Aware Reinforcement Learned Model Predictive Control
summary: Safe and efficient shape-aware navigation in heterogeneous crowds and robot fleets remains challenging. Traditional approaches often assume homogeneous robots, sparse workspaces, simplified geometry, offline computation, or handcrafted parameters to make the problem tractable, which limits their deployment in dense crowd scenarios. Toward this end, we propose Shape-Aware Reinforcement Learned Model Predictive Control (SRL-MPC), a method for safe, efficient, and adaptive navigation in crowds with heterogeneous shapes without geometry simplification. To encode shape-aware safety, we formulate high-order control barrier function (HOCBF) constraints from geometric separation features (GSFs) based on support function transformation. A reinforcement learning (RL) framework then learns a neural policy that reads GSFs and outputs real-time MPC parameter updates, enabling the MPC solver to adapt to neighboring crowd geometries. The key advantage of SRL-MPC is that it preserves the safety structure and generalizability of MPC while integrating the adaptability and intelligence of RL. Experiments in randomized crowd scenarios with arbitrary shaped robot fleets demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and robustness of SRL-MPC. The results show that SRL-MPC substantially outperforms representative baselines in safety and adaptability. Project website: https://hanruihua.github.io/srl_mpc_project/
tldr: SRL-MPC integrates reinforcement learning with model predictive control using shape-aware constraints for safe navigation in heterogeneous crowds without geometric simplification.
tldr_zh: SRL-MPC 通过结合强化学习和模型预测控制，利用形状感知约束实现异构人群中的安全导航，无需几何简化。
summary_zh: 摘要：在异构人群与机器人编队中实现安全高效的形状感知导航仍具挑战性。传统方法通常假设机器人同质、工作空间稀疏、几何形状简化、离线计算或使用手工参数来简化问题，这限制了其在密集人群场景中的部署。为此，我们提出形状感知强化学习模型预测控制（SRL-MPC）方法，该方法无需几何简化即可在具有异构形状的人群中实现安全、高效且自适应的导航。为编码形状感知安全性，我们基于支撑函数变换，从几何分离特征（GSF）出发构建了高阶控制障碍函数（HOCBF）约束。随后，强化学习（RL）框架学习一个神经策略，该策略读取GSF并输出实时MPC参数更新，使MPC求解器能够适应邻近人群的几何形状。SRL-MPC的核心优势在于：它在保留MPC安全结构与泛化能力的同时，融合了RL的适应性与智能性。在具有任意形状机器人编队的随机人群场景中的实验证明了SRL-MPC的有效性、可扩展性与鲁棒性。结果表明，SRL-MPC在安全性与适应性上显著优于代表性基线方法。项目网站：https://hanruihua.github.io/srl_mpc_project/

title: Teaching is a Process: The TOSS Framework for Modeling Human Teaching Decisions in Human-Interactive Robot Learning
summary: Successful Human-Robot Teaching assumes alignment between robot processing needs and human teaching intent. To better understand this alignment, this work seeks to uncover the underlying logic that humans intuitively apply when teaching. Through an exploratory, bottom-up study with N=34, participants observing two distinct robot Reinforcement Learning (RL) scenarios, we analyze 204 intuitive teaching responses across early, middle, and late learning phases. Results reveal that teaching decisions consist of a nuanced, interconnected network of Triggers (situational catalysts), Objectives (subjective teaching targets), Signals (communicative acts), and Strategies (high-level governance) in which teachers spontaneously adopt diverse roles, acting as coaches, engineers, or designers and prioritize different objectives. Based on these results, we introduce the TOSS Framework, which conceptualizes Human-Robot teaching as a procedural loop between robot behavior and human teaching actions, in which human teaching decisions are modeled as Trigger-Signal responses modulated by teaching Objectives and Strategies. It provides future research with an openly accessible dataset and a theoretical foundation for a) understanding teaching decisions and b) simulating realistic oracles as well as c) designing human-centered teaching settings and novel robot learning algorithms that go beyond the constraints of current robot learning settings.
tldr: The paper introduces the TOSS Framework, which models human teaching decisions in robot reinforcement learning as a loop of Triggers, Objectives, Signals, and Strategies, based on a bottom-up study with 34 participants.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 TOSS 框架，通过一项包含 34 名参与者的自下而上研究，将人类在机器人强化学习中的教学决策建模为触发器、目标、信号和策略之间的循环过程。
summary_zh: 成功的人机教学要求机器人的处理需求与人类的教学意图相匹配。为更好地理解这种匹配，本研究旨在揭示人类在教学时直觉应用的底层逻辑。通过对N=34名参与者进行探索性自下而上的研究，让参与者观察两个不同的机器人强化学习场景，我们分析了跨越学习早期、中期和后期阶段的204个直觉教学响应。结果表明，教学决策由触发因素（情境催化剂）、目标（主观教学靶点）、信号（沟通行为）和策略（高层管控）构成一个细微且相互关联的网络，其中教师自发扮演多种角色——如教练、工程师或设计师，并优先考虑不同的目标。基于这些发现，我们引入了TOSS框架，该框架将人机教学概念化为机器人行为与人类教学行为之间的程序化循环，其中人类教学决策被建模为由教学目标和策略调节的触发-信号响应。该框架为未来研究提供了一个开放获取的数据集和理论基础，用于：a) 理解教学决策，b) 模拟真实或acles，以及c) 设计以人为中心的教学环境和新型机器人学习算法，从而突破当前机器人学习设置的局限。

title: Rethinking Demonstration Unlearning in Imitation Learning for Robotics
summary: Imitation learning for robotics depends on human demonstrations, some of which people may later ask to remove. Retraining without them is the natural reference, but its cost grows with policy and dataset scale, motivating cheaper operators that edit a trained policy. Metrics inherited from machine unlearning, such as forgetting loss or a single membership attack, do not establish what an edit removed from a policy acting in closed loop. We therefore introduce a retrain-calibrated audit that reads demonstration unlearning along two axes: behavior, whether the edited policy acts like one retrained without the removed demonstrations, and evidence, whether an auditor can still detect it was trained on them. The behavior axis measures action divergence to that retrain at matched states, calibrated by a floor built from independent retrains, so a policy at the floor is as close to a retrain as retrains are to each other. The evidence axis applies a per-demonstration membership attack against a retrain null, reporting both its rank and its absolute member-loss level, since rank alone accepts operators that inflate member losses past the null. A conformal test then combines both axes into one hypothesis of joint retrain consistency, against a fleet of independent retrains large enough to reject at conventional significance. Across five preregistered conditions on three real-robot policy classes and two simulation suites, the axes dissociate in both directions on one checkpoint, as an edit may repair task behavior while leaving evidence unchanged, or reduce evidence while moving behavior away from retraining. On the ACT arm, a redirect edit restores blind-scored robot success to 18 of 20 trials.
tldr: This paper introduces a retrain-calibrated audit framework to evaluate demonstration unlearning in imitation learning for robotics, measuring both behavioral consistency with retraining and evidence of original training, and dissociates these axes across real-robot and simulation policies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于重训练校准的审计框架，用于评估机器人模仿学习中的演示遗忘效果，通过行为一致性和遗留证据两个维度进行度量，并在真实机器人策略和仿真策略上展示了这两个维度的可分离性。
summary_zh: 模仿学习在机器人领域的应用依赖于人类示范，但部分示范后续可能被要求删除。重新训练是应对这一需求的自然参照，但其成本随策略与数据集规模增长，因而催生了更经济的替代方案——直接编辑已训练策略。源自机器遗忘的评估指标（如遗忘损失或单次成员推理攻击）无法确定闭环决策策略中编辑操作的实际移除效果。为此，我们提出一种基于重训练校准的审计方法，从两个维度衡量示范遗忘效果：行为维度——评估编辑后策略的行为是否与移除相应示范后重训练的策略一致；证据维度——审计者是否仍能检测到原始训练数据中曾包含该示范。行为维度通过计算编辑策略与重训练策略在匹配状态下的动作散度来量化，并以独立重训练集构建的基准线进行校准——当策略达到基准线水平时，其与重训练策略的相似度与重训练策略间的相似度相当。证据维度则采用针对重训练零假设的单示范成员推理攻击，同时报告攻击排名与绝对成员损失水平——因为仅依赖排名会遗漏那些将成员损失推高至零假设范围的编辑操作。最终，基于共形检验的方法将两个维度整合为联合重训练一致性假设，通过足够规模的独立重训练舰队进行检验，以达到常规显著性水平。在预注册的五项条件中（涵盖三种真实机器人策略类别与两种仿真环境），所提维度在单个检查点呈现出双向解耦现象：编辑可能修复任务行为而证据特征不变，或减少证据痕迹却使行为偏离重训练轨迹。在ACT机械臂测试中，重定向编辑使20次试验中的18次机器人盲评成功恢复。

title: Is Multimodal Speculative Decoding Ready for Diffusion-Based Parallel Drafting? A Survey and Empirical Diagnosis
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by allowing a lightweight drafter to propose future tokens while a target model verifies them in parallel. Its lossless guarantee has motivated a line of work that pushes the drafter itself toward parallel generation. The most recent paradigm is block-parallel generative drafting, including diffusion-based methods such as DFlash and DSpark, achieving up to 3.6x speedup on common daily chatting tasks. While this transition is well studied in text-only LLMs, its applicability to multimodal models remains an open question. Existing multimodal speculative decoding efforts focus on input compression, adapter alignment, candidate coverage, or modality-specific verification; however, block-parallel generative drafting remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, this paper combines a modality-centered survey with a cross-architecture empirical study to ask: Is multimodal speculative decoding ready for diffusion-based parallel drafting? In this survey, we systematically analyze a wide spectrum of multimodal models, spanning Vision-Language, Video-Language, Audio, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures, from the dual perspectives of drafting parallelism and cross-modal information interaction. We introduce a unified taxonomy that isolates drafter-side parallelism from orthogonal design choices such as tree construction and verification strategies. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive empirical comparison of existing methods under varying degrees of parallelism across standardized multimodal benchmarks, including OCR, VQA, visual reasoning, and image captioning. Finally, we summarize the limitations of current approaches, discuss open challenges, and outline promising future directions for this rapidly evolving field.
tldr: This paper surveys and empirically diagnoses the application of block-parallel generative drafting (e.g., diffusion-based speculative decoding) to multimodal models, including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, concluding that the approach is not yet ready for deployment and identifying key challenges.
tldr_zh: 本文调查并实证诊断了将块并行生成草稿（例如基于扩散的推测解码）应用于多模态模型（包括视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型）的情况，结论是该方法尚未准备好部署，并指出了关键挑战。
summary_zh: 推测解码通过让轻量级起草者提前生成未来词元，同时由目标模型并行验证，从而加速自回归生成。其无损特性促使一系列研究推动起草者本身走向并行生成。最新的范式是块并行生成式起草，包括基于扩散的方法（如DFlash和DSpark），在常见日常对话任务上可实现高达3.6倍的加速。尽管这一转变在纯文本大语言模型中已得到充分研究，但其在多模态模型中的适用性仍是开放问题。现有的多模态推测解码工作聚焦于输入压缩、适配器对齐、候选覆盖或模态特定验证，然而块并行生成式起草在很大程度上尚未被探索。为填补这一空白，本文结合以模态为中心的调研与跨架构的实证研究，提出疑问：多模态推测解码是否已为基于扩散的并行起草做好准备？在本次调研中，我们从起草并行性与跨模态信息交互的双重视角，系统分析了涵盖视觉-语言、视频-语言、音频以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）架构的广泛多模态模型。我们引入统一的分类体系，将起草者侧并行性与诸如树构建和验证策略等正交设计选择加以区分。此外，我们在包括OCR、VQA、视觉推理和图像描述在内的标准化多模态基准上，对不同并行度下的现有方法进行了全面的实证比较。最后，我们总结了当前方法的局限性，讨论了开放挑战，并概述了这一快速发展领域中有前景的未来方向。

title: Neural-Primitive: An Efficient End-to-end Local Planner with Primitive-based Imitation Learning for Autonomous Flight
summary: Autonomous flight in unknown cluttered environments is hindered by the computation-quality-memory trilemma of onboard trajectory generation. In this paper, we propose an efficient end-to-end local planner via imitation learning. A lightweight offline-primitive-based dataset collection framework is designed to produce safe and high-quality trajectory primitives in non-convex environments. A compact neural network directly maps sensory inputs to polynomial coefficients that inherently encode higher-order dynamical information. The learned policy generates smooth, empirically collision-free and dynamically feasible trajectories in real time without back-end solving. It achieves ultra-fast computation (below 1ms on a standard desktop and average 3.68ms during onboard flight), while maintaining low onboard memory requirements (less than 1.5MiB). Extensive simulation benchmarks demonstrate superiority in both planning latency and target-reaching progress quality. Zero-shot deployment in real-world experiments further validates the robust sim-to-real transfer capability of the proposed method.
tldr: This paper presents an efficient end-to-end local planner for autonomous flight that uses primitive-based imitation learning to generate smooth, collision-free trajectories with ultra-fast computation and low memory, validated in simulation and real-world zero-shot deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自主飞行的高效端到端局部规划器，通过基于轨迹基元的模仿学习生成平滑、无碰撞的轨迹，计算速度极快且内存需求低，并在仿真和真实世界中验证了零样本迁移能力。

title: IMU-Free Body-Frame State Estimation with Sparse Scene Flow for Quadcopters
summary: We present a vision-only state estimation system for X-configuration quadcopters equipped with a canonical stereo camera pair and no inertial sensors. The system operates entirely in the body frame, requiring only synchronised stereo images and motor thrust commands. A continuous-discrete extended Kalman filter on a composite manifold state $\langle SE(3), \mathbb{R}^3, \ldots \rangle$ maintains estimates of body-frame pose, velocity, angular velocity, gravity, and disturbances, using stationary scene points as implicit inertial references. Feature points are detected (FAST, Shi-Tomasi), tracked temporally (SSD, Lucas-Kanade) and matched across cameras (NCC), with search regions predicted from filter-derived pose and point uncertainty. Chi-squared gating on the normalised innovation admits only stationary points to the filter. The system also produces a sparse 3D point cloud carrying per-point position, velocity and joint covariance. These come from a 4-view (two stereo pairs at two timestamps) full bundle adjustment that jointly estimates position and velocity from stereo disparity and temporal parallax, with the filter-derived relative pose as a prior. Feature points in the EKF do not enter the solver; their information is reflected through the pose prior. Point cloud density is spatially adaptive: an external focus point directs allocation, producing dense coverage in the region of attention and sparse coverage elsewhere. The output is a body-frame state estimate, a calibrated pose change, and a sparse scene flow. It is intended as a measurement source for a downstream world model anchored in the current body frame, without dependence on GPS, IMU, or any world-frame infrastructure, though the architecture accommodates their future integration.
tldr: A vision-only state estimation system for quadcopters using stereo images and motor thrust, no IMU, outputting body-frame pose, sparse scene flow, and 3D point clouds.
tldr_zh: 一种仅依赖视觉的无人机状态估计系统，使用立体图像和电机推力，无需惯性传感器，输出机体坐标系下的位姿、稀疏场景流和3D点云。

title: CIVA: Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks on Visual World-Model Agents
summary: Visual world-model agents such as DreamerV3 act through a recurrent latent state rather than a single observation, which weakens frame-wise observation attacks and makes their perturbations vary sharply over time under a strict per-frame perturbation constraint. We study white-box, causal, online attacks on such agents and propose Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks (\textbf{CIVA}). Our key observation is that, along a rollout, critic-guided perturbations concentrate in a low-dimensional subspace induced by the victim's own critic. Based on this observation, CIVA first probes the frozen victim offline with critic-guided PGD and extracts a low-rank value-subspace by SVD. At test time, it optimizes only the subspace coefficients, smooths them with an exponential moving average (EMA), and maps them back to pixels. This design attacks value-sensitive recurrent dynamics while keeping the online optimization cheap and temporally coherent. Extensive experiments on DMC walker walk, Atari Pong, and Crafter show that CIVA consistently outperforms five recent methods; on DMC walker walk, it achieves the largest reward drop of 26.07\% while keeping temporal variation low, with TempAbs of 0.646.
tldr: This paper proposes CIVA, a white-box adversarial attack on visual world-model agents (e.g., DreamerV3) that exploits the critic's value subspace to generate temporally coherent perturbations, significantly reducing reward while maintaining low variation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 CIVA，一种针对视觉世界模型智能体（如 DreamerV3）的白盒对抗攻击方法，利用评论家（critic）的价值子空间生成时间连贯的扰动，在保持低时间变化的同时显著降低奖励。

title: Belief Without Behavior: Measuring the Translation of Theory of Mind into Coordinated Social Action in Vision-Language Models
summary: Effective social interaction requires agents to translate mental state inferences into coordinated behavioral signals across verbal and nonverbal channels simultaneously.
